n = 22
solution = [15, 5, 7, 10, 18, 6, 17, 20, 4, 19, 16, 8, 21, 12, 3, 9, 14, 1, 11, 2, 0, 13]

# Check fixed
fixed = {11: 8, 16: 14, 18: 11, 21: 13}
for r, c in fixed.items():
    assert solution[r] == c, f"Row {r}: expected {c}, got {solution[r]}"
print("Fixed assignments OK")

# Check rows (trivially one per row)
assert len(solution) == n
print("Rows OK")

# Check columns
cols = set()
for c in solution:
    assert c not in cols
    cols.add(c)
print("Columns OK")

# Check diagonals
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        r1, c1 = i, solution[i]
        r2, c2 = j, solution[j]
        assert abs(r1-r2) != abs(c1-c2), f"Conflict between ({r1},{c1}) and ({r2},{c2})"
print("Diagonals OK")

print("Solution is valid!")
